title: Campaign settings
description: The JSON stored in campaigns.settings. Stored sparsely: rules holds only what the GM changed, and the server fills in the defaults when a campaign is read (server/rules/settings.py with_rule_defaults). Allowed content isn't here: it lives in the campaign_content_limits and campaign_content tables (server/db.py migration 9).

questions.description: The GM's custom questions, asked on the wizard's Details step under the character's name, in this order. Missing means none.

rules.description: The source of truth for campaign rules. The server reads each rule's default, limits and allowed values from here (server/rules/settings.py), and the TypeScript type is generated from it (npm run gen-types). Stored, every rule is optional: only what the GM changed. To add a rule, add it here with a default; the server refuses to start on a rule without one, or one using a keyword it can't check.

optionalClassFeatures.description: Allow the optional class features (extra options some classes gain at certain levels).

customizeOrigin.description: Let players move their origin's ability score increases and swap its proficiencies.

advancement.description: xp: characters start at level 1 and level up from experience points. milestone: the GM sets the level; new characters start at milestoneLevel.

milestoneLevel.description: The level new characters start at under milestone advancement.

hitPoints.description: automatic: each level past 1st gives the hit die's fixed average. manual: players roll or enter it.

featPrerequisites.description: When off, any feat can be picked regardless of its prerequisites.

allowMulticlass.description: When off, characters keep to one class and multiclassPrerequisites doesn't apply.

multiclassPrerequisites.description: Multiclassing requires the ability score minimums.

encumbrance.description: Track carrying capacity and apply the encumbered penalties.

ignoreCoinWeight.description: Coins count for nothing toward carried weight.

abilityScoreMethod.description: How ability scores are set. sharedManual: every player assigns the six sharedScores the GM set.

sharedScores.description: The six scores every player assigns under sharedManual.

startingEquipment.description: equipment / gold: every class and background uses that option. choice: players pick per option.

originFeat.description: background: the Origin feat the background grants. any: players pick any Origin feat.

characterApproval.description: New characters wait for the GM's approval before they can be played.

question.description: One custom question. id stays the same when the prompt is reworded, so answers keep matching it.

required.description: A character can't be created (or saved after an edit) without an answer.
